deals.description: ☎️ 1-855-547-4888 || 🌻 KLM Royal Dutch Airlines Vienna Office 🏢 Office Address: KLM’s passenger service point in Vienna is the KLM Service Desk in the Departure Hall at Vienna International Airport, 1300 Schwechat, Austria. A registered city office is also listed at Zollergasse 13, 1070 Wien, with another historical address at Kärntnerstrasse 49, 1010 Wien. 📍 Airport: Vienna International Airport (VIE), Terminal 1. KLM check-in counters are 188–193. 🏢 Office Overview KLM operates at Vienna Airport through its service desk in Terminal 1 rather than a full-service downtown ticket counter. Travelers can get help with reservations, ticket changes, baggage, and flight inquiries at the airport desk, through the Austria service line, or via KLM’s 24/7 global channels. 🧳 Key Services Assistance includes flight ticket booking, rescheduling, cancellations, check-in support (app, web, airport counter, kiosk), baggage allowance and missing luggage, unaccompanied minor services, visa information, lounge access (SkyTeam and partner lounges), seat selection, Flying Blue inquiries, and refunds. 📞 Contact Details KLM Vienna Airport Service Desk: +43 1 360 277 3460 (German & English) KLM Austria Toll-Free Line: +43 800 560 085 Vienna City Office (Zollergasse): Listed contact via +43 1 795 67 232 (historical Kärntnerstrasse listing) 24/7 Global Service Centre: +31 20 47 47 747 Online Contact: KLM Austria contact page & online form at klm.at 🌐 About KLM KLM Royal Dutch Airlines is the flag carrier of the Netherlands and part of the Air France-KLM Group, connecting Austria to Amsterdam Schiphol and onward worldwide through the SkyTeam alliance. 💡 Travel Tip: Check your flight status, confirm Terminal 1 departures at VIE, and review baggage rules before leaving for the airport. Use check-in counters 188–193 and arrive 2 hours before European flights and 3 hours before intercontinental flights. #KLM #KLMViennaOffice #Vienna #Wien #VIE #ViennaAirport #Schwechat #Terminal1 #TravelAssistance #KLMAustria

deals.title: Unbezahlte Werbung donmono_wien What makes it special?
deals.description: One of the most unique restaurants in Vienna, Austria!! If you love steaming bowls of ramen, delicious bao buns and Japanese food that looks just as good as it tastes, DONMONO deserves a spot on your Vienna food list. 🤍 unpaid ad!! Unbezahlte Werbung donmono_wien What makes it special? The mix of Japanese comfort food, flavour-packed broths, colourful toppings and a menu that goes beyond just ramen. Plus, the casual, modern setting makes it a great stop for lunch, a relaxed dinner or your next foodie date. 🍜 What to order & prices: 🥟 Japanese Gyoza (6 pieces) — check the current menu 🍞 Bao Buns with chicken or beef — €5.90 each 🍗 Japanese Chicken Karaage — €6.90 🍜 Tonkotsu or Spicy Tantan Ramen — €16.90 🍛 Chicken Katsu Curry — €14.90 🍚 Bulgogi Don — €13.90 💸 Price range: Around €15–25 per person for a main and possibly a side, depending on what you order. 📍 DONMONO, Vienna — available at Donauzentrum and Millennium City. Save this spot for your next ramen craving & follow janinascheurer for more food spots, hidden gems and places worth visiting! 🫶🏻 Who would you take here?
